newsitem.title: FRANCE: Suez special dividend would affect parity - Monod.
newsitem.headline: Suez special dividend would affect parity - Monod.

text.p: An exceptional dividend payment by holding company Cie de Suez to its shareholders ahead of its planned merger with Lyonnaise des Eaux would affect the share parity fixed for the merger, Lyonnaise head Jerome Monod said on Thursday.
He said nothing had been decided yet on the merger, due to be discussed by both boards on April 11.
"The principle is clear. If there is an exceptional dividend payment, it will have an impact on the parity," he told a news conference.
Suez said on Tuesday it would make an exceptional dividend payment to its shareholders for an unspecified amount to reflect capital gains made last year.
Monod declined to give details of the merger talks and said it was impossible to comment on newspaper reports about the amount of money likely to be paid in a special dividend.
Saint Gobain head Jean-Louis Beffa suggested a payout on Tuesday of an amount equivalent to 3.4 billion francs.
He said his call for an exceptional dividend was shared by other Suez shareholders including insurer Axa-UAP and bank Banque Nationale de Paris.
